name: compact-keeper
description: Compaction without amnesia: the summarizer is told to keep your goal, constraints, decisions and paths verbatim, a card with your goal, prompts, pinned notes, edited files and open todos follows the summary, and the full transcript before compaction is archived as markdown.

archive.title: Archive the transcript
archive.description: Before each compaction's result is installed, write the conversation so far as markdown to the archive folder.

archiveDir.title: Archive folder
archiveDir.description: Where archives go; ~ is your home. Empty means ~/.claude/compact-keeper. Each file lands under <project>/<session-id>/.

maxPrompts.title: Prompts to keep
maxPrompts.description: How many of your latest prompts the card carries across compaction. 0 keeps none.

instructions.title: Extra summary instructions
instructions.description: Appended to what the summarizer is told on every compaction, after the mod's own instructions.
